_annotation.name: Courses & Workshops (cursos.json)
_annotation.what: Training services catalog — items with name, price (PYG), duration (minutes), description, and popularity flag.
_annotation.why: Course and workshop listings with clear pricing and duration help potential students self-qualify before reaching out. This reduces low-intent inquiries and increases booking conversion.
_annotation.ai_popolates: Course names and descriptions: Generated from your curriculum. Prices: AI validates against market rates. Duration: Calculated from stated content volume. Popular flag: Auto-set based on demand signals.
_annotation.your_input: List your courses/workshops with price, duration, and description. We format them into the catalog structure.
